dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: You know how merchants in a hurry sometimes dangle a little food in front of their Sumpter Beast's face, right? To get them to move faster?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: I think people are the same way. Give them a little hope, and they can achieve a whole lot more. Take their hope away, and they never seem to succeed.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: So, I'll explore this place with you to the end. Let's never stop hoping for victory.
